contacts_org_email_idx.name: contacts_org_email_idx
contacts_org_email_idx.where: "contacts"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "contacts"."deleted_at" IS NULL

contacts_org_phone_idx.name: contacts_org_phone_idx
contacts_org_phone_idx.where: "contacts"."phone" IS NOT NULL AND "contacts"."deleted_at" IS NULL

user_preferences_typed_value_check.name: user_preferences_typed_value_check
user_preferences_typed_value_check.value:
("user_preferences"."value_kind" = 'text' AND "user_preferences"."value_text" IS NOT NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_number" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_boolean" IS NULL) OR
      ("user_preferences"."value_kind" = 'number' AND "user_preferences"."value_text" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_number" IS NOT NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_boolean" IS NULL) OR
      ("user_preferences"."value_kind" = 'boolean' AND "user_preferences"."value_text" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_number" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_boolean" IS NOT NULL) OR
      ("user_preferences"."value_kind" IN ('list', 'object') AND "user_preferences"."value_text" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_number" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."value_boolean" IS NULL)
